Meet the Boys Team

The Boys Basketball Team is a friendly and energetic group of students who come together to enjoy basketball, improve their skills, and build strong teamwork. We regularly play and train together while creating a fun and positive atmosphere for everyone.

Meet our Girls Team

The Girls Basketball Team is a friendly and energetic group where students come together to enjoy basketball, improve their skills, and build strong teamwork. Through regular training and games, we create a positive atmosphere where everyone can have fun, stay active, and grow together.

NORTH CAMPUS ⇄ SOUTH CAMPUS

Training Programs

Our basketball teams train once or twice a week, depending on the schedule and available facilities. Training locations may vary between the North Campus and South Campus, while the choice of indoor or outdoor courts also depends on the weather conditions. This flexible schedule allows everyone to enjoy training and playing comfortably throughout the year.

INDOOR COURTS OUTDOOR COURTS 1–2× WEEKLY
VS. XIDIAN UNIVERSITY

Friendly Matches

We regularly organize friendly matches with strong teams from Xidian University. These games give our players the opportunity to challenge themselves, gain valuable experience, improve their teamwork, and build connections with other teams across the university.

CLUB TOURNAMENT

Club Tournament

The club organizes a tournament to put members' practice skills to the test in a fun yet competitive environment.

XIDIAN CUP

Tournament

Although we unfortunately did not win, we are very proud of our performance, teamwork, and effort throughout the competition. This experience motivated us to keep improving, and we are already looking forward to coming back stronger for the next Xidian Cup!
